text: EX-005: gaps found. Please add sections for the following uncovered files using the standard 5-question format: (1) e2e/badge.spec.js — covers reactivity for both badge and label types (attribute change updates caption) and visual snapshot baseline; document this as a behavioral confirmation. (2) e2e/dataTypes.spec.js — badge-web supports string, integer, long, decimal, AND enum attribute types for both badge and label display; enum rendering (caption text, e.g. 'C Success') is a distinct behavioral finding not present in the draft. (3) e2e/onClick.spec.js — only nanoflow is tested (not microflow, open page, etc.); document which action types are e2e-confirmed and note that the test also confirms data context is passed to the nanoflow. (4) src/components/__tests__/Badge.spec.tsx — unit tests confirm: empty string value renders without error (no isAvailable guard), role='button' is set for onClick and onKeyDown independently, custom className/style/tabIndex are supported.
